criteria.requirement: Conferir 28 capacidades sem linha órfã e sem exclusão silenciosa.
limitations: Inventory and current registry reconciliation; legacy baseline execution and all UI commands not observed.
criteria.current_evidence: The CI test compares all28 inventory entries with real current navigation and domain registries and checks non-orphan destinations.

criteria.requirement: Encontrar destino para Talent Review, stakeholders, performance contract, suppliers/settings, FX e allocations, além dos fluxos mais visíveis.
limitations: Inventory and current registry reconciliation; legacy baseline execution and all UI commands not observed.
criteria.current_evidence: Talent Review, stakeholders, performance contract, suppliers/settings, FX and allocations are explicit in the inventory and destination map validated by the baseline CI test.

criteria.requirement: A matriz lista cada capacidade e comando observado, destino, owner e cenário de preservação.
limitations: Inventory and current registry reconciliation; legacy baseline execution and all UI commands not observed.
criteria.current_evidence: The pinned matrix lists the28 observed capabilities, page/domain commands, roles, formats, source blobs, destinations and preservation cases; CI reconciles the current registry.

criteria.requirement: Nenhuma regra de alçada, classificação contábil ou permissões é alterada por preferência estética.
limitations: Inventory and current registry reconciliation; legacy baseline execution and all UI commands not observed.
criteria.current_evidence: No approval threshold, accounting classification or business permission is changed. The observed floating-point failure was fixed in the test tolerance only.

criteria.requirement: Distinguir capacidade atual, proposta nova, defeito comprovado e hipótese; citar a origem de afirmações sobre o código.
limitations: Inventory and current registry reconciliation; legacy baseline execution and all UI commands not observed.
criteria.current_evidence: Baseline decisions distinguish observed source behavior, approved new scope, permitted semantic changes and unexecuted hypotheses; source revisions and owners are explicit.

criteria.requirement: Cobrir as três superfícies, import/export, efeitos de escrita e saídas de relatório; registrar itens sem evidência suficiente.
limitations: Inventory and current registry reconciliation; legacy baseline execution and all UI commands not observed.
criteria.current_evidence: The inventory names all three surfaces, import/export, write effects and report outputs; baseline execution and unobserved UI commands are explicitly limited.

criteria.requirement: Um revisor consegue identificar exatamente quais comportamentos a campanha preserva e quais resultados pretende melhorar.
limitations: Inventory and current registry reconciliation; legacy baseline execution and all UI commands not observed.
criteria.current_evidence: The baseline matrix and decision guide give the reviewer preserved behaviors and proposed improvements without claiming all destination features already work.

criteria.requirement: Planner: budget 600000, actual 400000 e forecast 190000 com item 72000 produzem outlook 590000; substituições por 84000/78000 produzem 602000/596000.
criteria.current_evidence: The real Planner produces590000 baseline outlook and602000/596000 after the once-only license replacements, retaining600000 budget and monthly context.

criteria.requirement: Procurement: EUR28000×1,08=USD30240; A USD32400 pontua aproximadamente87,9333; B85; C não conforme fica fora do ranking.
criteria.current_evidence: The real FX consumer yields30240 within1e-8 USD numerical precision; real quote assessment yields A87.9333/B85 and excludes ineligible C while retaining submitted FX.

criteria.requirement: Um relatório com 20 registros conserva os 20 ou declara explicitamente um resumo escolhido.
criteria.current_evidence: Both real DOCX and PPTX renderers retain the20 diagnostic record identities exactly once. This assertion does not claim the separate25-record J05 journey.

criteria.requirement: Corpus, resultados esperados e roteiros foram conferidos e não dependem de respostas geradas pelo próprio código sob teste.
limitations: No30 measured UI repetitions; J01-J08 and generic import/revocation transitions remain unqualified.
criteria.current_evidence: Independent numeric constants and complete monthly fixtures are consumed by real domain/report implementations. Full journey qualification and comparable visual measurement remain separate.

criteria.requirement: Dados são sintéticos identificados; nenhuma série mensal é inventada interpolando um total anual.
criteria.current_evidence: All data is labeled synthetic; Planner uses explicit monthly vectors. The separately named legacy annual fallback is not treated as an observed monthly series.

criteria.requirement: Fixtures são pequenas para diagnóstico e incluem volume representativo para o uso de tabelas, sem dados decorativos.
limitations: No30 measured UI repetitions; J01-J08 and generic import/revocation transitions remain unqualified.
criteria.current_evidence: Small diagnostic cases and deterministic1000/200/100 volume fixtures are exercised by real functions. This does not by itself prove loaded table behavior or visual latency.

criteria.requirement: Cada pacote de prova cobre vários axiomas por relações explícitas; resultados esperados vêm de oráculos independentes, nunca de copiar a função a testar.
limitations: No30 measured UI repetitions; J01-J08 and generic import/revocation transitions remain unqualified.
criteria.current_evidence: The journey/corpus maps bind multiple axioms to explicit independent expected constants; tests do not obtain their expected numbers by calling the implementation under test.

criteria.requirement: Cobrir alternativas, branco/zero/herdado, períodos distintos, informações restritas, import reexecutado e evento de ressubmissão.
limitations: No30 measured UI repetitions; J01-J08 and generic import/revocation transitions remain unqualified.
criteria.current_evidence: Alternatives, role restriction, stale writes, absent FX, legacy inherited budget and distinct approval/resubmission are covered. Complete import replay and all period/reload journeys remain unqualified.

criteria.requirement: Qualquer executor consegue reproduzir os mesmos deltas, permissões e transições a partir do corpus.
limitations: No30 measured UI repetitions; J01-J08 and generic import/revocation transitions remain unqualified.
criteria.current_evidence: CI reproduces the stated numeric deltas and selected role/transition cases from versioned fixtures. It does not establish every host/UI/native permission or journey.
